connector_capacity_rule: A candidate with P contacts per breakpoint is adequate only if all actual physical routes assigned through it total <= P; other interfaces need their own accounted breaks. No spare pin count is claimed before that inventory is closed.
default_break_obligation: Every connected carrier/B01 route must meet the accepted mode-isolation contract; implementation may use different domains/breaks only after design review. No two-break count is adopted as a Founder product decision.
